description: This PHP source file defines a class OutboundEmailAccountsViewDetail that extends a ViewDetail class, responsible for rendering the detail view of outbound email account records in SuiteCRM. It includes license and header comments related to SugarCRM and SuiteCRM.

classes.name: OutboundEmailAccountsViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail, responsible for displaying detail view of outbound email accounts, with a custom display method that assigns an 'is_admin' variable to the view template.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to assign the 'is_admin' variable to the view based on current user's admin status, then calls the parent display method.
